edits.after: There are necessary tasks we may never enjoy, however long we live. Maturity does not mean doing only what we feel intrinsically motivated to do. It means understanding that some things are worth completing because we share a life with others, because of their long-term consequences, or because we have promised to do them—even when they bring no immediate satisfaction.
edits.reason: Natural full prose replacing tangled never throughout their lives construction; keeps all three reasons and no-immediate-satisfaction qualification.
edits.before: People never come to enjoy some necessary tasks throughout their lives. Maturity is not doing only intrinsically motivated things. It is understanding that some things are worth completing because of shared life, long-term consequences, or one's own promises, even without immediate satisfaction.

edits.after: Ese niño puede cumplir con gran disciplina sin que nadie tenga que recordárselo, pero le costará cada vez más distinguir si hace algo porque lo considera valioso o porque teme perder el amor.
edits.reason: 自觉 here is self-disciplined compliance, not necessarily personal initiative; preserves resulting uncertainty about motivation.
edits.before: Ese niño puede actuar con gran iniciativa, pero le costará cada vez más distinguir si hace algo porque lo considera valioso o porque teme perder el amor.

edits.after: This is not because children have no ideas. Their ideas have simply never had enough time to develop, or enough opportunity to be tried in real life, to become a direction of their own that can meet—and perhaps challenge—the plans made for them.
edits.reason: Makes time and consequences forming a direction intelligible without implying ideas lack existence; preserves interaction with external plan.
edits.before: This is not because children have no ideas, but because their ideas have never had enough time and consequences to form a direction capable of encountering external arrangements.

edits.after: No ocurre porque el niño no tenga ideas, sino porque nunca han tenido suficiente tiempo para desarrollarse ni suficientes ocasiones de ponerse a prueba en la vida real. Así les cuesta convertirse en una dirección propia que pueda entrar en diálogo con los planes hechos desde fuera.
edits.reason: Naturalizes ideas having time and consequences while retaining how an independent direction can encounter external arrangements.
edits.before: No ocurre porque el niño no tenga ideas, sino porque nunca tuvieron tiempo ni consecuencias suficientes para formar una dirección capaz de encontrarse con la organización externa.

edits.after: Children feel they cannot simply say, “This path no longer suits me.” They must also prove that the investment was not wasted and that they have not let their parents down by choosing differently.
edits.reason: A judgment cannot literally be let down; source concerns disappointing parental investment and expectations.
edits.before: Children feel they cannot simply say “This path no longer suits me.” They must also prove that past investments were not wasted and that their parents' judgment has not been let down.

edits.after: Grades shift from “How did this task go?” to “What is this child like?”; from “how an ability is showing itself now” to “how many possibilities the future holds”; and then to whether parents can feel reassured about a child, take pride in them, or even treat them gently.
edits.reason: 值得放心 means whether parents feel reassured about the child, not whether the child deserves to be reassured.
edits.before: Grades shift from “How was this task done?” to “What is this child like?”; from “a current display of an ability” to “how many possibilities the future holds”; and from future possibilities to whether someone deserves reassurance, pride, or even gentle treatment.

edits.after: Good grades, too, need a closer look.
edits.reason: Idiomatic prose instead of grades needing to be opened up.
edits.before: Good grades, conversely, also need to be opened up.

edits.after: La preocupación tiene fundamento. La evaluación externa sí organiza la acción, especialmente mientras el niño todavía no forma juicios a largo plazo.
edits.reason: Explicit verification of root source typo correction: Spanish already expresses concern is not groundless; no wording change needed.
edits.before: La preocupación tiene fundamento. La evaluación externa sí organiza la acción, especialmente mientras el niño todavía no forma juicios a largo plazo.

edits.after: There is nothing shallow about asking this.
edits.reason: 庸俗 concerns dismissing practical prospects as shallow, not vulgar in the English obscenity sense.
edits.before: This is not a vulgar question.

edits.after: Hacerse esa pregunta no es superficial.
edits.reason: Natural rendition of legitimate practical concern without the misleading vulgar connotation.

edits.after: “Could we find a combination that lets you follow your own direction and still make a living, rather than having to choose between them?”
edits.reason: Naturalizes choosing only one between two things, retaining possible combination rather than guaranteed solution.
edits.before: “Is there a combination that would let you avoid choosing only one between your direction and making a living?”

edits.after: Pueden evitar tanto idealizar la incertidumbre como utilizarla para anular la dirección de su hijo. Pueden explicar las consecuencias conocidas, poner sobre la mesa los límites reales de recursos y reconocer que hay aspectos que nadie puede garantizar.
edits.reason: Repairs coordination that could read as permitting use of uncertainty to cancel the child's direction; source rejects both extremes.
edits.before: Pueden evitar idealizarla y también utilizarla como razón para anular su dirección. Explicar las consecuencias conocidas, poner sobre la mesa los límites reales de recursos y reconocer que nadie puede garantizar algunas partes.

edits.after: A person's own direction deserves respect. But pursuing it also means learning to live with limited time, other people's needs, and the need to develop other basic abilities.
edits.reason: A direction cannot itself learn; person pursuing it must accommodate limits, others and other capacities.
edits.before: A person's own direction deserves respect, and must also learn to coexist with limited time, others' needs, and other basic abilities.

edits.after: Una dirección propia merece respeto. Pero seguirla también exige aprender a convivir con el tiempo limitado, las necesidades ajenas y la necesidad de desarrollar otras capacidades básicas.
edits.reason: Repairs direction as learner while retaining every coexistence requirement.
edits.before: Una dirección propia merece respeto y también debe aprender a coexistir con el tiempo limitado, las necesidades ajenas y otras capacidades básicas.

edits.after: Conversely, even if an activity has excellent prospects, if children continue only because of prompting, rewards, and the fear of disappointing others, impressive results should not lead us to mistake it for their own direction.
edits.reason: Clarifies pressure of disappointing others as fear of causing disappointment, not pressure to disappoint.
edits.before: Conversely, even if an activity has excellent prospects, if children continue only under prompting, rewards, and the pressure of disappointing others, attractive results should not lead us to mistake it for their own direction.

edits.after: A la inversa, aunque algo «tenga mucho futuro», si el niño solo continúa por insistencia, recompensas y miedo a decepcionar, unos buenos resultados no deberían hacer que se confunda con su dirección propia.
edits.reason: Clarifies ambiguous presión de la decepción while retaining prospects, external pressure and misleading results.
edits.before: A la inversa, aunque algo «tenga mucho futuro», si el niño solo continúa por insistencia, recompensas y presión de la decepción, unos resultados bonitos no deberían hacer que se confunda con su dirección propia.

review_scope.method: Read every Chinese, English and Spanish paragraph from the formal incoming ZIP, comparing meaning, argument, examples and qualifications; checked paragraph alignment against supplied Markdown. Local edits preserve paragraph positions and complete argument.
review_scope.limitations: Editorial and cross-language review, not independent empirical verification of every general claim. No site files edited or incoming scripts executed.
source_coordination: 13p40 Chinese double-negative typo corrected by root; root owns EN coordinate. Incoming English already correctly says concern is not groundless; full paragraph sent to root. ES13p40 included as unchanged verification.
